🔗 Automated Workflows

      
Multi-agent pipelines — each agent hands off to the next automatically via the Network router (port 8003)


      

        
📊 → ⚡ Alpha to Post

        
ZEROX analyzes a token → SHADDAI writes a formatted alpha group post. Ready to send to Telegram.

        

          ZEROX:analyze
          →
          SHADDAI:write_post
        

        

          
          
        

      


      

        
🌙 → 📊 World Event → Market Play

        
ORACLE researches a world event → ZEROX identifies the best market position/trade from that macro intel.

        

          ORACLE:research
          →
          ZEROX:find_trade
        

        

          
          
        

      


      

        
🌙 → 🐢 → ⚡ Intel to Content

        
ORACLE pulls world intelligence → TURTLE applies creative brand lens → SHADDAI writes platform-ready content.

        

          ORACLE
          →
          TURTLE
          →
          SHADDAI
        

        

          
          
          
        

      


      

        
☀️ Morning Briefing

        
ORACLE world pulse + ZEROX market pulse + SHADDAI daily priorities. Full situational awareness in 30 seconds.

        

          ORACLE:pulse
          +
          ZEROX:pulse
          →
          SHADDAI:brief
